spanish: Desde hijo de veinte año y arriba, todo saliente ejército en Israel, contarán a ellos a sus ejércitos, tú y Aarón.

findings.issue: כָּל in construct heads the qal participle יֹצֵא (every one going out); צָבָא is that participle’s singular absolute complement. “todo saliente ejército” makes the army the head and “saliente” its adjective, so the army is what goes out and the one who goes out is no longer the participant.
אֹתָם is the only direct object; לְצִבְאֹתָם is lamed plus plural hosts plus “their.” The second “a” can be read as another direct object, so the hosts are also counted.

notes: contarán is the ustedes form of the 2mp imperfect; tú y Aarón matches אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן.
